A '''droid parts shop''' was located in the [[Rana'Inrull District]] of the [[Duros Sector]], on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:TLoN" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref> [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and [[Talos Drellik]] intended to visit the shop in order to acquire a part for an antique [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and therefore get access to [[Darth Nul's Laboratory]] on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]]. However, the shop had been closed by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].<ref name="TOR:TLoN" />
